brand.shareImageHint: Shown when the site link is shared on WhatsApp and social media. Best size 1200×630.

typography.baseSizeHint: Every size on the site scales with it.
typography.sample: Fine gold & jewelry with unique designs

layout.stickyHeader: Keep the top bar visible while scrolling
layout.breadcrumbs: Show the page path (Home / Categories / Rings)
layout.breadcrumbsHint: The small line at the top of category, product and other pages. Switch it off to hide it on the whole website.

card.title: Product cards

soldOuts.overlay: Shade over the picture with "Sold out"

card.hoverImage: Show the second picture when the mouse is over it

texts.intro: Change any fixed text on the website. Leave a field empty to use the original text.
texts.keepPlaceholders: Keep words in braces like {karat} as they are — they are filled in automatically.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.hint: How the website will look after publishing
preview.noAccess: View only — editing is for the website designer or owner.

cropper.title: Choose what shows from the logo
cropper.hint: Move and zoom the picture until the part you want is inside the frame — like a WhatsApp profile picture.

shapeHints.square: Icon only — the store name is written next to it on the website.
shapeHints.wide: Logo that contains the store name — the written name is hidden and the logo shows alone.

cropper.preview: How it will look at the top of the website
cropper.loadError: Couldn't open the picture. Upload it to the media library, then choose it from there.
cropper.saveError: Couldn't save the picture. If it's from another website, upload it to the media library first.

links.hrefHint: e.g. /products, /pages/about, a full https://… address, or tel:+2010… — a link shows once its text (both languages) and address are filled.

reset.header: Reset the header to the original
reset.footer: Reset the footer to the original
reset.filters: Reset the filter to the original
reset.productPage: Reset the product page to the original

chrome.moved: The logo, the header and footer colours and everything about them are edited only in their own pages:

header.subtitle: Everything about the bar at the top of the website: arrangement, logo, colours, menu links, icons and the announcement strip. Changes are a draft until you press “Publish”.

layoutHints.logo-start: Logo, then the menu, then the icons (the usual one).
layoutHints.logo-center: Menu on one side, logo in the middle, icons on the other side.
layoutHints.stacked: Logo and icons on the first row, the menu on a row under them.

header.sticky: Stays at the top while scrolling
header.showName: Store name next to the logo
header.showNameHint: “Automatic”: the written name is hidden only when the logo is wide (already contains the name).
header.hoverAuto: No special colour: the link fades a little on hover.
header.menuHint: On phones the same links appear inside the ☰ menu button.

links.pages: Pages added to the top menu (from Site pages)

header.announcementHint: A small strip above the header, e.g. “Free delivery this week”.
header.iconThemesHint: Click a set to change every icon at once, or choose each icon yourself from the library below.
header.transparent: See-through header over the first picture
header.transparentHint: The header sits on top of the homepage slider (or a page's title banner when it has a picture) with no colour. After scrolling down, and on other pages, it goes back to its normal colour.
header.transparentOpacity: How much header colour over the picture
header.transparentOpacityHint: 0% = fully see-through. Raise it to blend the header colour with the picture.
header.transparentBlur: Blur the picture behind the header (frosted glass)
header.transparentText: Text and icon colour while see-through
header.activeHint: How the link of the page the visitor is on looks, e.g. “Products” while browsing products. In the sketch above, the second link shows it.
header.activeAuto: Automatic: the hover colour if you chose one, otherwise the header text colour.
header.activeTextAuto: Automatic: white or dark, whichever is easier to read on the shape.

menuPages.title: Which pages show in the menu?
menuPages.autoHint: The pages set to “Top menu” in Site pages:
menuPages.none: No page chosen yet — add one below.
menuPages.chosenHint: A page that isn't published doesn't show until it is. Set the order of all links in “Arrangement of the menu” below.

menuOrder.title: Arrangement of the menu
menuOrder.hint: The links in the order they show on the website (number 1 comes first). Use the arrows to move a link earlier or later.

dd.categoriesDropdown: Open a drop-down list of the categories
dd.pagesDropdown: Put the pages under one drop-down
dd.whichCategoriesHint: They show in the order you tick them. None ticked = all main categories.
dd.lookHint: How the lists under the menu look (e.g. "Shop ▾", "About ▾").

pos.title: Positions
pos.hint: Place every part of the header where you want it on computers: in the top strip, the main row or the bottom row, at the start, in the centre or at the end. Phones keep a simple header.
pos.orderHint: ↑ ↓ change the order of parts that share the same row and area. Untick a part to hide it.
pos.textHint: The strip text, its link, phone icon and colours are set in "Announcement" below.
pos.layoutOff: Positions are on, so the arrangement and menu position here don't apply on computers. Height, width, line and shadow still do.

searchBar.title: Search bar
searchBar.hint: The bar that opens when the magnifier in the header is clicked.
searchBar.wordsHint: Leave empty for the default ("Search products…").
searchBar.floatingLabel: Words as a small title on top of the field
searchBar.buttonTextHint: Leave empty to show the magnifier only.

textOn.hover: Only when the mouse is on the button

searchBar.autoHint: Automatic colours follow the site colours: frame and button = main colour, button on hover = accent colour. In the sketch, the second button shows the hover look.

header.transparentLogoHint: Uses the “Logo on dark backgrounds” from Theme & design → Brand. After scrolling the normal logo comes back.
header.transparentGradient: Soft dark shade at the top of the picture

footer.subtitle: Everything about the bottom of the website: arrangement, parts and their order, logo, colours, links, contact details and the last line. Changes are a draft until you press “Publish”.
footer.partsHint: Switch on what you want to show, and order it with the arrows (the first one shows first).

links.pages: Pages added to the footer (from Site pages)

footer.contactHint: Choose what shows. The details themselves are edited in
footer.socialHint: Only networks that have a link in Store details are shown.
footer.bottomTextHint: Leave empty for the automatic “© year store name”. You can write {year} for the year and {store} for the store name.
footer.transparentHint: The page background shows instead of the footer colour. Choose a text colour that is readable on the page background.

contactDisplayHints.details: Each detail on a written line (Phone: …).
contactDisplayHints.icons: Icon buttons only; clicking calls, or opens WhatsApp / email / the map.
contactDisplayHints.both: A small icon next to each detail.

contactDirections.row: Side by side in a row

footer.taglineHint: The tagline text itself is edited in

x.groupsHint: Columns you build yourself: a title with links and/or a short text (e.g. Working hours). Turn on "Own columns" in Parts & order to show them.
x.contactUnderAbout: Show them under the logo (no own column)

socialPlacements.row: Centred row above the last line
socialPlacements.top: In a row at the very top (with the newsletter)

x.topHint: A newsletter box and a thin picture (e.g. a gold chain) above the columns.
x.newsletterHint: Empty = the default words. Sending the addresses to a mailing list is added with the backend.
x.dividerHint: Optional. White parts of the picture blend into the footer colour.
x.bottomMark: Small oval mark in the middle
x.bottomEndHint: E.g. EST · *Cairo* · 26 — *stars* = italic words. With the mark or these words the line has three parts.

filters.subtitle: The filter column of the product pages on the website: which sections show, their order, and which categories are listed. Changes are a draft until you press “Publish”.
filters.sectionsHint: Switch a section off to hide it, and use the arrows to change the order.

sectionHints.offers: Shows by itself only while a special offer is running (Gold prices & coupons → Special offer).
sectionHints.karat: Shows when the shop has more than one karat.
sectionHints.metal: Shows when the shop has more than one metal.

filters.categoriesHint: To create, rename or delete a category itself, use the Categories page.
filters.noneChosen: Nothing added yet — all main categories show until you add one.
filters.empty: All sections are off — the filter column will be empty.

place.title: Where & how it shows
place.hint: On computers. Phones always get a "Filter" button that opens a panel from the bottom.

displays.drawer: A "Filter" button that opens a panel

place.buttonPosition: Button place in the bar above the products

productPage.subtitle: The page customers see when they open a product: what shows on it, where the photos sit, and which button stands out. Changes are a draft until you press “Publish”.
productPage.partsHint: Switch off anything you don't want customers to see.

parts.stock: Stock label (In stock, Only a few left…)

hints.whatsapp: Needs a WhatsApp number in Settings → Store details.
hints.priceBreakdown: Gold value, making charge and stones. Never shown on fixed-price pieces.

productPage.imageSideHint: First = on the right in Arabic, on the left in English. On phones the photos are always on top.
productPage.textsHint: To change the words on the buttons: Theme & design → Texts.
productPage.weightHint: To hide the weight: Settings → Store details → Website options.
productPage.buttonsHint: Order, look and colours of each button. The sketch shows the result.
productPage.whatsappAuto: Automatic = plain outline, or WhatsApp green when filled.
productPage.align: Position of the text and buttons
productPage.alignHint: Title, price, details and (side by side) the buttons. Start = right in Arabic, left in English.
productPage.detailsHint: How the product name, price, sizes and quantity look.
productPage.cardPriceFormatHint: Uses the sign and piastres from Layout → Product cards (e.g. "LE 96,065.00").
productPage.quantityOwnRow: "Quantity" on its own line above the buttons

galleries.stack: All photos one under the other

productPage.galleryHint: The colour behind the photos follows Layout → Product cards → Behind the pictures.

dark.enabled: Offer dark mode on the website
dark.enabledHint: On = a sun / moon button appears in the top bar. Visitors switch with it and their choice is remembered on their device. Off = the website is always in its normal colours.
dark.firstHint: Before they press the button themselves.
dark.reset: Back to the suggested dark colours

media.rules: Any file type — up to {mb} MB each

errors.too_large: The file is larger than 50 MB.
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

crop.title: Choose what shows from the picture
crop.hint: The frame is the exact shape of this picture on the website. Drag the picture to choose the part that shows, or fit all of it inside.

bulk.warn: Files in use will disappear from the website.

media.imagesOnly: Pictures only here (PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF…), up to 50 MB.

home.title: Homepage
home.hint: The blocks of the store's first page, top to bottom. Changes are saved as a draft — press Publish to put them on the website.

editor.published: Published — the page is live on the website.
editor.discardConfirm: Go back to the published version and delete all unpublished changes?
editor.unpublishConfirm: The page will disappear from the website (its content stays as a draft). Continue?

editor.incomplete: Fill in the highlighted fields in both languages before publishing:

settings.title: Page title
settings.linkFixed: This main page has a fixed link.
settings.menuHint: Changing where it shows applies right away.
settings.seoHint: Leave empty to use the page title.
settings.systemNoDelete: Main pages (About, Contact, FAQ, Terms) can't be deleted — you can take them offline.

fields.subtitle: Text under the title
fields.label: Label
fields.question: Question

fields.showContactInfo: Show phone, WhatsApp and address next to the form
